correctness.rationale: Determinant rank differentiation proves all rank≤2 points singular and rank3 singular iff unique projective plane tangent at duplicated point. Smooth quadric Gauss injectivity and ruling-line decomposition classify rank3 as exactly 12 closed tangent-pair loci. Rank≤2 is exactly 2 rulings plus 7 two-value loci. Parameter isomorphisms, generic mutual noncontainment, and dimension counts prove exactly 21 reduced components. A generic conic-plane incidence proves irreducibility; codimension-two singular locus plus hypersurface S2 proves normality. Symbolic integer Hessian computations at four rational witness orbits give ranks 3,4,4,4; openness and complex Morse–Bott yield generic quadratic transverse types. F2 enumeration corroborates but cannot prove C over C.

value.rationale: The fundamental four-point Segre determinant appears naturally in multiprojective incidence and computer-vision geometry. Its exact complete singular stratification, twelve previously unaccounted rank3 tangent-pair components, and generic quadratic transverse analytic types are structural information not recoverable from a determinant equation or rank≤2 classification alone; normality follows sharply. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
